notes: Page states the listed serials are utilized with all Paloma brand systems. All five styles are encoded from this page's own text; usesStylesOf is null (no sister reuse is claimed, even though the page's illustration images carry Rheem filenames). Week-before-year order for styles 2, 4 and 5 follows the page's own wording (week and year, in that order) and is corroborated on the same page by style-3's explicit week-then-year positions; the alternative year-first split fails plausibility on style 2 (year 28) and style 5 (year 72 is valid but week-first is the page's stated order, and style 3 fixes the order). Counting convention: character positions govern; digit-only counting is falsified on style-3 (week 91, invalid) while character counting decodes every page example validly.
